plain_english_policy: Mandatory private insurance purchase with no explicit public alternative stated.

effects.rationale: Penalizes uninsured individuals (likely lower-income or self-employed) without direct subsidies, shifting costs to taxpayers via enforcement mechanisms.
Explicitly focuses on private insurance markets; no mention of public programs or government-run healthcare.
Restricts individual autonomy to opt out of insurance coverage, framing it as a mandatory obligation rather than a voluntary welfare benefit.

evidence_quote: "requiring individuals to purchase health care insurance"
